LvRatioBadSharePct.meaning: share of displayed (k, tau) cells where the Dupire ratio is inadmissible (negative calendar increment or g_D <= 0)

LvRatioBadQuotedSharePct.meaning: same share restricted to the common quoted support of each expiry pair

LvRatioLocMinPct.meaning: smallest extracted local vol (%) on the common quoted support

LvRatioLocMaxPct.meaning: largest extracted local vol (%) on the common quoted support

LvLatImplMinDens.meaning: min discrete density under fully implicit Euler (plot window)

LvLatCnMinDens.meaning: min discrete density under undamped Crank-Nicolson (plot window)

LvLatCflBound.meaning: CN monotonicity bound 2 dy^2/(v y^2) at the money on this lattice (the marching step 0.01 exceeds it)

LvWrongMaxSpikePct.meaning: largest extracted local vol (%) in the naive pipeline

LvWrongNBad.meaning: strikes at which the naive extraction returns negative variance or a nonpositive Durrleman factor

LvWrongFwdMaxPts.meaning: max |fitted - true| local vol (vol points) along the two plotted cross-sections of the forward fit to the noisy quotes

LvWrongRippleBp.meaning: amplitude (vol bp) of the deterministic alternating ripple

LvIdentMovePts.meaning: vol points taken off the unquoted deep-put column

LvIdentColY.meaning: strike of the moved vertex column

LvIdentMaxDiffBp.meaning: largest reprice change (vol bp) across every quote

LvIdentRmsDiffBp.meaning: rms reprice change (vol bp) across every quote

LvInflMaxRel.meaning: worst relative disagreement, analytic tangent vs central FD, over all vertices and expiries

LvInflVtx.meaning: vertex count of the synthetic sheet

LvRtMaxErrBp.meaning: max quote reprice error (vol bp), clean synthetic round trip

LvRtRmsErrBp.meaning: rms quote reprice error (vol bp), clean synthetic round trip

LvRtSurfRmsPts.meaning: rms |fit - truth| local vol (vol points), quote-covered region

LvRtSurfMaxPts.meaning: max |fit - truth| local vol (vol points), quote-covered region

LvRtEvals.meaning: objective evaluations of the synthetic fit

LvWrongQuoteRmsBp.meaning: reprice rms (vol bp) of the forward fit to the rippled quotes: the noise stays in the residual, not the surface

LvWrongEdgePts.meaning: max |fitted - true| local vol (vol points) anywhere on the common quoted support: the short-expiry span edges, where single rippled quotes meet weakly identified vertices

LvSheetVtx.meaning: SPY sheet vertex count (= calibration parameters)

LvSpyRmsBp.meaning: SPY all-quote rms (vol bp), fitting operator

LvSpyConvBp.meaning: SPY all-quote rms (vol bp), refined operator

LvSpyWorstConvBp.meaning: SPY worst per-expiry refined-operator rms (vol bp)

LvNvdaRmsBp.meaning: NVDA all-quote rms (vol bp), fitting operator

LvNvdaConvBp.meaning: NVDA all-quote rms (vol bp), refined operator

LvNvdaWorstConvBp.meaning: NVDA worst per-expiry refined-operator rms (vol bp)

LvSpyButterflyMin.meaning: SPY min divided second difference of the marched prices over every expiry (butterfly proxy)

LvSpyCalendarMin.meaning: SPY min adjacent-expiry increment of the marched prices at fixed y (calendar proxy)

LvNvdaButterflyMin.meaning: NVDA min divided second difference of the marched prices over every expiry (butterfly proxy)

LvNvdaCalendarMin.meaning: NVDA min adjacent-expiry increment of the marched prices at fixed y (calendar proxy)

LvWrongCoarseMinPct.meaning: smallest valid extracted local vol (%) in the 13-quote arm

LvWrongTruthAtmPct.meaning: true ATM local vol (%) at tau = 0.25
